crossRefs.note: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead…
Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all…
Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed…
that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
“Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.
Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.…
I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and…
Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

translations.web: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
translations.bsb: In the wilderness I said to their children: ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
translations.kjv: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
translations.asv: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.
